# High School Accommodation Planning Snapshot

Subject: Differentiation and Special Education Support
Grade band: 9-12
Resource type: Planning Snapshot
NYS framework label: NYS Learning Standards with UDL-aligned access supports

## Short Description
A teacher-facing snapshot for translating accommodation needs into daily lesson planning moves.

## Alignment Note
Supports access to grade-level instruction through planned supports and clear routines.

## Classroom Use Case
Use while planning a unit, assessment, seminar, lab, or project for diverse learners.

## Preview Content
- Barrier in the task
- Support before, during, or after
- How independence is preserved

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
